source: It's time for battle, <n1001>!
I'll explain how fighting works in this world!
target: ¡Te explicaré cómo funciona la lucha en este mundo!

source: Here, fighting is your partner's job!

By selecting a command at the
top of the screen, you can give an order!

You can use either the Analog Stick
or the Directional Pad.

The name of the command you select is
displayed above the command menu.

Sometimes battles can be hard to follow.
If you want to have a better view,

you can use the L&R Buttons to
change the camera.

When times are tough, you can
support us by giving us items!

Well, let's give it our best shot!
Watch me, <n1001>!

There, <n1001>!
The finishing gauge is full.

By using your special skill, 
you can deal extra damage!

Press □ when the finishing gauge is full
to unleash it!

Stop the attack gauge with ○ in the
success zone and the power will be doubled!

But be careful!
Enemies have special skills too!

If you stop the gauge at this point,
it will increase your Defense!
If you time it right, you'll take less damage!

And now, let's settle this!
Let's do it, <n1001>!

Before everything returns to the void...
Digitize and renew the world.

The top executives have informed me
that the experiment is canceled.

Have they decided the entire project is a
failure? That can't be! The program isn't a
failure, it shows great potential. I must be firm,
and protect my research at all costs.

Information flows in all minds. It must be
provided equally, with everyone given access.
A truly open source.

Even if I am ridiculed for my optimism, I must
not give up.

Light shines in a place of ideals. Challenging
oneself with problems like these is what makes
life interesting.

I AM RIGHT HERE.

WHERE AM I?

NO ONE IS AROUND.

IT'S SO EMPTY.

SHOULD I GO LOOK AROUND?

IS THERE SOMEONE WHO WILL FIND ME?

BIT BY BIT
MY EYES OPEN.

BIT BY BIT
I BEGIN TO UNDERSTAND.

I WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT THIS WORLD.

I completed it in secret. The program, which
began as an experiment, has at last moved
beyond both the bounds of theory, and my
control.

It has begun acting on its own. I am troubled.
Was this truly for the best? If this new life
cannot be controlled, have I committed an act
that goes against God?

While I have found no answer to this question,
the program has begun to grow autonomously.

SO MANY MEmories

SO Many words flow into me.

WHAt is this pLace?

Someone toLD ME.

This is the Digital WoRLD.

THIS Is the Real World.

This is that WHIch is in between.

So much information...

—Minds—
Minds pass before my eyes at incredible speed.
Just by reaching out a hand, I can access all
information. I can access all minds. Then what

Cyber terrorism has occurred throughout the
world in recent years.

Memorably, a virus program that infiltrated
network servers made all data communications
throughout the world unusable, plunging the
world into chaos.

The first to restore their servers amidst the
confusion was GIGO, which had already been
researching server systems prior to the attack.

Once its existence was hypothesized by GIGO, a
team of researchers composed primarily of
Russians was brought in.

Their goal was to find proof that a digital world
existed parallel to our own.

It is said that the preparations GIGO made, which
no one paid attention to at the time, became the
foundation for of the replacement server
infrastructure which was quickly created in
response to the cyber terrorism incident.

After the worldwide cyber terror attacks that
sparked GIGO's rise to the number one position in
the data communications industry, the company
began to provide many services that later became
deeply involved with consumers' daily lives.

Today, GIGO has become an irreplaceable part of
many of the world's households.

The GIGO Company's server maintenance,
which was extended for much longer than
planned, officially ended early yesterday
morning.

There was no explanation as to why this
maintenance took far longer than
scheduled, but rumors about it are floating
throughout forums all over the network.

Among these rumors are a few wild theories
that GIGO's online service had not only lost
their data but also a live human being, who
is now trapped in cyberspace.

As usual, GIGO Company has offered no
official comment about this maintenance.

The GIGO Company was able to make its
great strides in the midst of the worldwide
network disruption called the “Digital
Divide”.

How was GIGO Company able to supply
their usual network service without being
affected?

GIGO extols their discovery of the digital
data domain known as the “Digital World”,
which holds overwhelming capacity,
as well as the creation of their practical
application technology.

But rumors on the net that this official
statement is false and that it was actually the
GIGO Company that arranged the never
ending Digital Divide.

The head of GIGO's online program
division, Dr. Yakjov Borisovich Petrov, has
been confirmed as a missing person.

The doctor is a world renowned authority
on the “practical application of large-scale
digital storage”, and cries of suspicion
about his disappearance, his possible
connection to the “Digital Divide,” and
whether GIGO Company's service will
continue to be stable have risen once more.

Today, the GIGO Company has announced
their official statement on Dr. Petrov's
disappearance.

It states that the doctor had left the
company for personal reasons, and that this
was in no way connected to any major
concerns about the company's service, nor
has this compromised the security of highly
classified information.

On the other hand, some specialists are of
the opinion that he foresaw the many security
holes discovered recently, and calculated his
leave accordingly.

Even within the industry, opinions among
representatives of the same company are
greatly divided.

Lately, the game “Digital Monsters”, which
uses the GIGO Company's network, has
seen a massive boom among junior high
and high school students.

The object of the game is to be the Tamer
of a digital life form known as a “Digimon”,
and to make these “Digimon” fight each,
other while raising it online.

The game appears to be highly addictive,
there are even adults who are obsessed
with it, and its popularity has reached
unknown heights.

The media has discovered that Yuuya Kugo
(14), son of the GIGO Company's Mr.
Kenzou Kugo, has been missing for several
days.

The police have already begun a search on
the theory that it was a kidnapping, but the
family has yet to be contacted by the
supposed kidnappers.

Yuuya is a strongly independent boy, with a
history of acting alone. His father stated
that he is not deeply worried at this time.
However, the facts of the situation are still
under investigation.

Early this morning, the water was cut off to
one residential community in the
metropolitan area.

The cause is currently being investigated,
but no problems could be found with the
water pipes in the vicinity. Service was
restored several hours later, with the cause
still unknown.

General speaking, being unable to
determine the cause of an outage is highly
irregular.

A large-scale power failure within the Kanto
region that began last night and continued
intermittently throughout the day, was
finally restored this evening.

The economic loss resulting from the
phenomenon was enormous. Preliminary
calculations found that the suspension of
transportation facilities affected at least 2.4
million people.

The outage was apparently caused by a
temporary overload during the GIGO
Company's server maintenance.

The frequency of unusual events affecting
water supply, electricity, gas, and other
basic utilities has the attention of the
administration. It has now been announced
that the utilities in the effected districts, as
well as the service management network
system, are controlled by a GIGO Company
guidance program.

Following the announcement that the
guidance program, which is not made
publicly available, was at fault, requests have
been made to make information on the
program be made available to the public.

In response, the GIGO Company has
announced that they are beginning legal
proceedings to make disclosure of the
application's source code only to
administration officials.

Immersion into the internet, which
accompanies any obsession with an online
game, has increased among youths. These
people are said to be “lost”.

The term originally referred to being
absorbed in games and “losing” connection
to reality. However, given recent incidents
where users of the game have physically
gone missing while logged in, it has taken
on connotations of “disappearing” as well.

Earlier today, a high-density flow of data,
which exceeded the expected capacity,
flowed into the infrastructure operated by
the GIGO Company.

Currently, a large part of the network is
congested and incredibly difficult to utilize.

It is bringing serious affects to society, and
quite likely to aggravate public order to an
unprecedented degree.

The following information has not yet been
confirmed:

In the sky above the GIGO Company Tower,
located within the center of the city, a giant,
lightning-shaped “slit” was seen this
evening. It has not disappeared, and is still
visible.

The meteorological observatory is
scrambling to identify it, but no
explanations or precedents have been
found so far.

Specialists everywhere are completely
baffled.

After several days, it is now apparent that
the “tear” in the sky has increased in size.
Currently, the skies above the central city
appear to be losing their structure.

Studies by the meteorological observatory,
along with network communications
everywhere, have been suspended. As
such, details about the phenomenon are
impossible to determine.

There are rumors that a similar
phenomenon occurred in an online game
several days prior to this incident, but any
connection between them has yet to be
established.

If this situation continues, it seems clear
that it will have effects on all aspects of
public order. Extreme caution is necessary
as the situation continues.

Early yesterday morning, several
unexplainable events occurred.

At a local shopping mall, there were
multiple cases of shoplifting.

While the thief was caught in the act, none
of the police officers present at the scene
were able to capture the criminal.

The general explanation given from them
was that they were suddenly overcome
with depression.

The police are currently tracing the
criminal's whereabouts, as well as
investigating the officers' change in
mentality.

Some eyewitnesses have reported seeing a
monkey-like being wearing sunglasses at
the scene, but details are unclear.

Each Digimon has up to three dispositions.
The dispositions are listed below, in order of
strong to weak. Fire - Ice - Air - Earth -
Combat- Machine - Light - Darkness - Filth.
Fire is strong against earth. Earth is strong
against air. Air is strong against ice. Ice is
strong against fire. Combat and Machine are
weak against each other. Light and darkness
are weak against each other. Combat/
Combat, Light/Light, Darkness/Darkness,
and Machine/Machine do not interfere with
each other. Filth is strong against Machine.
Filth is also little strong against Light and
Darkness, but weak to everything else.

attributes: DATA, VIRUS, or VACCINE.
These attributes have the following power
dynamic: Data is weak against Virus, Virus is
weak against Vaccine, and Vaccine is weak
against Data. Digimon will act belligerently
toward those they are strong against, while
avoiding those they are weak against.

Digimon have “discipline” that changes

its Tamer. When Discipline is low, the Digimon

If a Digimon does not use the toilet often
enough, it will build up a “Grudge” that, if high
enough, can impede digivolution.

A newborn Digital Monster. On the surface of
its slime-shaped body, it has grown a thick,
black fuzz.

Its whole body is covered in a tough fur, called
Mythril Hair. This slime Digimon manifests an
aggressive personality immediately after birth.

This Digimon's whole body is covered in a
substance with the appearance of long, soft
hair. This seed Digimon, when it hatches from 
its Digi-Egg, seeks a suitable environment to 
grow in, and drifts lightly through the air like 
a dandelion seed.

This Fresh Digimon drifts with its translucent
body, through the Net Ocean, like a jellyfish. 
It has the most primitive structure of any
Digimon discovered, to date.

An extremely rare Digimon, with a small
population. Few Fresh-level dragon Digimon
are born, and it is said that most of them end
up being captured, or die before they can
grow up.

A tiny Digimon that shed the fuzz covering its
surface, and whose body has grown. Although
it has reached the point where it can move
around more actively, it is still unable to battle.

A Digimon created from the fusion of the data
of small pet animals, such as dogs and cats.
Because of its surprisingly fast movements,
caution is needed to prevent it from running
away. It can become very emotionally attached
if cared for as a pet.

Blended from the data of various poisonous
plants, it has the form of a flower bud. Usually,
it drifts through the air carried by its leaf, and
doesn't attack as long as nothing happens.

A small Digimon which has limb-like objects
growing under its body (head?). In-Training
Digimon that have grown limbs are quite rare,
and their appearance is extremely cute.

A four-legged In-Training Digimon that
digivolved from Jyarimon. Its physical features
resemble those of Tokomon, and it has also
powerful fangs growing within its mouth.

Having grown up and become able to walk
on two legs, it is a reptile Digimon which has
an appearance like a tiny dinosaur. Because it
is still growing, its power is low, but its
personality is quite ferocious, and it doesn't
know fear.

This Digimon is thought to be a subspecies of
the sharp clawed Gazimon. With its agile
movements, it specializes in hit-and-run
attacks.

A baby bird Digimon, part of its wings have
developed as arms. It is able to use its arms
dexterously to grip objects, but cannot fly well.

A type of Digimon that was only recently
discovered. As a survivor of a species that
flourished during the Genesis of the Digital
World, it is able to perform Armor digivolution, 
a pseudo-digivolution using certain Digi-Eggs.

A mutant machine Digimon shaped like a gear.
There are countless gears incorporated into its
body, and the gears are constantly rotating.

A flame Digimon whose Digi-Core, which is
said to be its heart, burns vigorously on its
head. One theory states that the flame is it's
real body, and that the wax exists only to act
as a decoy.

A mouse-like Digimon who always gets
Sukamon into trouble. It has a strong
friendship with Sukamon, though it may be
that only Chuumon feels this way.

Although similar in appearance to Patamon, it
has quite the opposite personality. It's
considerably devious and usually acts as a
familiar for Digimon such as Devimon. It uses
negative energy to quickly end battles.

A cyborg Digimon with a shell like a computer
mouse. With its Shell Guard, it has the ability
to tuck his entire body into its shell and repel
all enemy attacks. Only its helmet sticks out.

A holy-beast Digimon wreathed around a holy
cartridge. It is said that day after day, it
accumulates holy power within the earring on
its left ear, and that the stored power is great
enough to influence its next digivolution.

A plant Digimon with the appearance of a
flower bud. It spins the leaf on its head to fly
unsteadily. Expressionless, but charming.

A Digimon with the appearance of a demon
child. It loves pranks, and it enjoys seeing its
opponents embarrassed.

This Digimon has the appearance of a dinosaur
in its youth. Although it is still a Rookie, its
potential as a combat species, something
inherent to all Digimon, is very high, and it
hides the ferocious personality of a
carnivorous beast.

A mammal Digimon characterized by its large
ears. It is able to fly through the air by using its
ears as wings. But, because it can only fly at a
speed of 1 km/h, it moves faster when
walking.

A familiar Digimon with the appearance of a
bat. His offensive powers are not particularly
strong, but he is cunning, and often plots evil
deeds here and there.

BlackGabumon is a Gabumon which digivolved
as a Virus-type. Its fur pelt seems to have been
taken from a Virus attribute Garurumon.

A Digimon with rather flashy and bright colors.
It is said to be a variation of Gabumon. Its
personality is just as bright and flashy as its
body color. Like Gabumon, it is hesitant to
remove its fur.

A troublesome Digimon in the form of a small
demon that loves to do bad things. Having a
sly nature with no courage, it never acts alone.
Always in a group, it hides in the shade of a
tree in the forest, making it its attack from a
hiding spot.

A type of Agumon suited to life in a snowy
field. It inherited Agumon's naughty nature,
and whenever snow falls, it frolics like a child.

An Agumon with its wild instincts awoken, that
became a Virus-type. Not only is it fearless,
but it also has a ferocious personality. The
sharpness of its attacks when it goes for its
opponent is on par with the Vaccine-type
Agumon.

Although covered by a fur pelt, it is
nevertheless a reptile Digimon. Due to its
extremely timid and shy nature, it always
gathers up data Garurumon left behind, and
shapes it into a fur pelt to wear.

A mechanical-system Digimon that seems to
be a rare species of machine Digimon.
Researchers are uncertain as to whether or not
it is a mutation of Hagurumon. The truth
remains a mystery.

An insect Digimon which, despite its hard
shell, is not very aggressive. It has one hard
claw on each of its fore- legs, and four on each
of its middle- and hind-legs. The middle-legs
are able to skillfully grasp objects, much like a
human hand.

An amphibious Digimon that became able to
move on land, and is covered in fur to maintain
its temperature. The short, white fur that
covers its body gets longer as it grows, and it
is said to discolor into brown fur when it
grows up.

A plant Digimon with a tropical flower
blooming on its head. Although it digivolved
the reptilian Tanemon, it is an unusual type
which is classified as a plant Digimon based on
its outward appearances and characteristics.

A beast Digimon. Due to the old-fashioned
Digicore-Interface it bears on its forehead, it
has been conjectured to be an experimental
“Prototype Digimon” from before Digimon
were first discovered.

An infantry Digimon who is a member of the
mechanized “D-Brigade”. The D-Brigade is a
mechanized brigade consisting of draconic,
cyborg Digimon. Its special forces are
concealed from the public.

A dinosaur Digimon. The skin of its head has
hardened so that it is covered in a beetle-like
shell. It is an extremely aggressive Digimon,
with a body like a lethal weapon, covered in
sharp claws and gigantic horns.

Gaomon's physique has gotten larger, and it
has grown into beast Digimon whose hard
claws are protected by gloves. Although it is a
quadruped, with its tenacious leg strength, it
can stand up to attack, like a bear.

A gigantic bird Digimon in the form of a
Phoenix. Like Meramon, it was generated from
the internet's defensive wall, the “Firewall”.

A Champion-level mythical-dragon Digimon
that digivolves from Veemon when it obtains
power. ExVeemon is a pure breed of
Veedramon, and it is also said to be a
derivative of the Veedramon species.

A fire Digimon whose entire body is shrouded
in crimson flames. As a Digimon that was
generated from the defensive “Firewall,” it
protects the Internet from illegal entries.

A mythical-beast Digimon that grew gigantic
wings. It is a very valuable monster, said to
have an existence close to that of a god.

Covered in blue, white, and silver-colored fur,
it is a beast Digimon which has an appearance
similar that of a wolf. With furious combat
instincts, its muscles have been hardened in
freezing lands, and it bears carnivore-like
agility and accuracy which it uses to kill its
prey quickly.

A ghost Digimon who is covered from top to
bottom in cloth. Its evil presence was born
from darkness. It is said when Bakemon
possesses a computer, it will instantly destroy
its system.

A Virus-type Gatomon with fine, pitch black
fur. It is a hell-sent child of pure evil, that lives
and wanders through darkness.

A unique Digimon that is assumed to be a
subspecies of Greymon. Its body and the
carapace on its head have developed into
lethal weapons, and its appearance is more
aggressive.

A plant Digimon which has an appearance
similar to a sunflower. When it bathes in the
sun's light, it becomes very energetic, and its
offensive power rises. On days when the
weather is good, it will also flap the leaves on
its back to fly around.

A mollusk Digimon with a slug-like body. It
prefers dark, gloomy environments, and is
neither strong, nor intelligent. Supposedly,
poor upbringing leads Digimon to digivolve
into Numemon. However, some say this
Digimon hides a powerful secret.

A beast-man Digimon called the King of the
Beasts, Leomon is a noble hero. While most
Digimon are savage, it possesses a strong will
and a heart of justice and has defeated many
heinous Digimon.

A Demon Dragon Digimon referred to as the
Crimson Demon Dragon. The childishness it
had when it was Guilmon has vanished, and it
digivolved into a wilder, more ferocious
Digimon.

An angel Digimon with six shining wings,
dressed in divine, pure white clothing. It is a
being of perfect virtue, and it is said to be a
Digimon that brings happiness to others.

A yellow, Data-type Growlmon. Compared to
is viral counterpart, it is calm, with a simple
personality, but when something happens it
quickly gets fired up.

A lover of pranks with a very strong sense of
curiosity. Although its body is small, it is a
precious holy Digimon, and its appearance
belies the immense strength it possesses.

A fallen-angel Digimon which wraps its body in
jet-black clothing. It was originally a shining
Angemon, but when the space of the Digital
World became distorted, it fell into the Dark
Area and became a fallen angel.

A Digimon referred to as the “Jet-Black Demon
Dragon”. Although it was originally a normal
Growmon, and is still essentially the same
species, it shows a stronger viral nature.

A fallen-angel Digimon with a heart as cold as
ice. Even for a Devimon, which it is said to
have digivolved from, it is particularly brutal
minded. It sweet talks its enemies with its
brilliant conversation skills, only to encase
them in ice with its wings.

A Virus-type variant of Garurumon. Its
shoulder blades are so sharp that they cut
everything into pieces.

A beast Digimon very similar to Garurumon. A
violent Digimon that lives in darkness, it likes
to cause trouble everywhere it goes.

A soft-bodied Digimon of the same species as
Numemon. While its attack power is low, it
assaults all who comes near it with unexpected
violence. Naturally, it ends up being defeated,
but it immediately forgets the loss.

A newly discovered species of Digimon, it is a
fairly unusual Insect Digimon. As its mind is
also that of an insect, it only possesses the
instincts necessary for survival, and as a result,
it has no discernible intelligence.

A Digimon shaped like golden, glittering poop.
It was born when dregs of data thrown into the
Recycle Bin of a desktop computer gathered
and mutated.

A sea-animal Digimon discovered in the
computer of an Arctic research base. Thanks
to its thick fur, and robust body, it is able to
survive in even the coldest of environments.

A machine Digimon that protects the
defensive wall of a computer network.
Essentially, Guardromon's only programming
instruction is to defend.

An aquatic Digimon that has a long, snakelike
body. It has no inherent intelligence, and
swims around the Net Ocean, guided solely by
its instincts.

A plant Digimon that has taken the form of a
huge cactus. It is able to store nutrient data in
its body. and thus, can even survive over long
periods of time in the desert.

It is said that only the one that passes the
“Selection-D”, a special selection test that
screens one hundred Commandramon, can
digivolve into a Sealsdramon.

A cyborg Digimon that mechanized the upper
half of its body. In order to digivolve to
MetalGreymon, it must fight and defeat the
formidable opponents who come against it.

A cyborg Digimon who carries a rocket
engines enormous propulsive power on its
back. Although its flight duration is short, it
takes maximum advantage of the engines'
great thrust. It is especially skilled at making
hit-and-run attacks.

A bird-man Digimon with huge talons, and
wings that allow it to dance freely through the
sky. Garudamon honors justice and order. It is
a guardian deity of the land and wind, and
loves nature.

A Digimon that is the result of a DNA
digivolution between ExVeemon and
Stingmon. It possesses a strong sense of
loyalty and would give its life for its master.

An arch-angel Digimon who bears eight
shining, silvery wings. MagnaAngemon's
mission in the Digital World is that of a law
enforcement officer, whose duty is to
supervise and watch over the many angel
Digimon.

A female fallen-angel Digimon of noble stature.
Because of its strength, due to the
incomparable purity of its Dark Side Power, its
spread on personal computers is said to be
infinitesimal.

A Digimon that is completely shrouded in
mystery. While it appears to be a plush bear, it
is rumored that someone got inside, through
the zipper on its back.

A cyborg Digimon who has mechanized more
than half of its body. The huge revolver on
its left arm is said to produce such a huge
force that its power is comparable to a nuclear
warhead.

A fairy Digimon with the appearance of a lilac,
a flower that is loved by everyone. It is pure
and innocent, and despite its beautiful
appearance, it is said to preside over
death and rebirth.

Revived by the power of darkness, Myotismon
is the king of the undead Digimon, who
obtained tremendous powers. Very cruel and
cunning by nature, it is difficult to eradicate
this Digimon.

A species of Seadramon that survived the
harsh environment around the Folder
Continent, that has digivolved in order to
survive the harsh survival-of-the-fittest Digital
World.

A Ultimate-level cyborg Digimon, its body has
become huge. Its upper body is coated with
the strongest metal, Chrome Digizoid.

An Ultimate-level cyborg Digimon that
digivolved from BlackGrowlmon. While similar
to BlackGrowlmon, its viral nature shows more
clearly, and it is referred to as the “Black 
Destruction Dragon”.

This bipedal beast Digimon has digivolved
from Garurumon. Although it lost a fair amount
of its speed in becoming a biped, its offensive
and defensive abilities became stronger, and it
has developed tactical skills.

An arch-angel Digimon shaped like a beautiful
woman. Although its personality is extremely
gentle, it won't forgive those who are crooked
or evil, so it won't stay its hand until the
opponent is reformed.

A fire Digimon whose flames burn even hotter
than those of the Champion-level Meramon.

This Digimon digivolved from a Virus-type
Garurumon. Although it lost a fair amount of its
speed in becoming a biped, it gained stronger
attack power, and the ability to use skills that
involve both arms.

A Data-type cyborg Digimon that digivolved
from Growlmon. It is armed with the strongest
metal, Chrome Digizoid. With its two verniers,
it is capable of performing anti-air attacks.

A digivolution of Kabuterimon that was
discovered within the tropical region of the
Net Area. Its behavior, in addition to its
survival instincts, is that of a protector of the
weak, and there are even times when it shows
knight-like behavior.

An unidentified Digimon that suddenly
appeared in the Digital World. It's the self-
proclaimed “King of Digimon,” and its combat
power is beyond imagination.

A humanoid cyborg Digimon. It possesses a
fighting strength which can defeat any
Digimon below Ultimate-level in a single blow.

Ikkakumon digivolves into this powerful
Digimon capable of walking on two legs. Its
muscles have been thoroughly trained, and it
protects itself with armor made from the skin
and shells it took from its opponents.

A cyborg Digimon who acquired strong power
through the remodeling of its body. Just as
Megadramon was remodeled for anti-air use,
MetalTyrannomon was remodeled as an anti-
ground interceptor Digimon.

Among the Ultimate-level dragon Digimon, this
dark-dragon Digimon boasts that it posses the
strongest and deadliest power.

The strongest cyborg Digimon, after going
through numerous battles, it was able to
survive by mechanizing more than half its
body.

A machine Digimon that functions as the riot-
suppression and assault-extermination for the
mechanized “D-Brigade”. It specializes in the
extermination of hordes of “Targets”, and it
boasts overwhelming firepower.

The strongest dragon warrior, with a body clad
in armor of the super-metal, Chrome Digizoid.
It is the Mega form of Greymon-species
Digimon.

A beast-knight Digimon whose whole body is
covered in an armor made from Chrome
Digizoid. As a result of its incomparable speed,
enemies perceive it as a mirage.

A holy Digimon that bears four shiny, golden
wings. It is said to be the leader of all the
sacred and bird-type Digimon.

A Virus-type WarGreymon who is feared as the
“Jet-Black Dragon Warrior”. This Digimon
despises cowardice and foul play, and it
doesn't consider other Virus Digimon to be its
allies.

A light-dragon Digimon that stores up, and
fights with scorching solar energy. It can
summon the “GeoGrey Sword,” which
possesses the power of Gaea, from solid earth.

A subspecies of WarGreymon, whose body is
clad in armor of the super-metal, Chrome
Digizoid. It easily wields its gigantic sword, and
it is the “Dragon Warrior of Heroes” that fights
against its enemies with its unique sword
techniques.

A fairy Digimon which lives in the Net Ocean,
and whose form can rarely be seen. Although
its name contains “Angemon”, as far as the
ecosystem is concerned, it is a completely
different species.

A fairy Digimon, that has the appearance of a
the rose, which is said to be the queen of
flowers. It has the looks of a beautiful woman,
and desires to remain beautiful forever.

A rare form of Numemon that found a
“Platinum Mine” and digivolved by
incorporating the element. Appearance aside,
it is a gorgeous-to-the-touch Digimon.

A Beast Man Digimon that lives only faithful to
the justice it believes in. The “GAKU-RAN”
worn over its shoulders is endowed with a
defensive function that negates 89.9% of the
opponent's physical attacks.

A Cyborg Digimon which is believed to be the
weapon of last resort to the mechanized “D-
Brigade”. Even now it is said be wandering in
search of the codenamed “BAN-TYO”...

Chaosmon is the codename for Digimon who
“should not exist,” and according to the
“Central Dogma” of the Digital World, are
absolutely impossible singularities.

The final form of Garurumon, which powered
itself up by metalizing almost its entire body.
Even after undergoing metalization, it has
managed to retain its natural agility. It can also
pulverize the opponent with the countless
weapons hidden on its body.

A Virus-attribute MetalGarurumon that has
equipped its body with cold-bearing weapons.
It uses its laser sights to detect prey, which it
chases down, wildly firing missiles without
regard for friend or foe. A fearful Digimon.

The final form of Garurumon and a subspecies
of MetalGarurumon. It is the ultimate beast-tank
Digimon, equipped with the superdreadnought
class weapon, the “Zeed Cannon”.

The ultimate Insect Digimon, which digivolved
by combining data of Kabuterimon- and
Kuwagamon-species. It has a gigantic horn and
scissors, and it can be said that its form
perfectly compensates for the weaknesses of
its component Digimon, which have opposing
natures.

By studying its own weaknesses from data it
obtained through battles, this Digimon, by full
metalizing itself, has been completely reborn
as the ultimate combat machine. It calls itself
the “King of Digimon”.

A Mega-level beast-man Digimon that rules
over frigid areas of permanently frozen
ground, which will never ever melt. Its fur has
become like ice crystals, the hardness is said
to be comparable to Chrome Digizoid.

An alternate form of Gallantmon, whose
Virus-attribute instincts have awakened. Its
mind and soul have been completely taken
over by the dark side, bringing disaster to the
Digital world.

A Demon Lord Digimon which is said to be the
final form of Myotismon. It has a cruel, spiteful
and ruthless nature, and it will resort to
anything to ensure its own desires are fulfilled.

A Demon Lord Digimon that was once a high-
level angel Digimon. It is the executive officer
of the Nightmare Soldiers and is known as
their “Earl”. It is the ruler of 30 legions of
Demons.

One of the many Demon Lord Digimon in the
Dark Area. Although, just like Daemon, it used
to be a high-ranking Angel Digimon.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a wild boar. It serves the
Digimon Sovereign Ebonwumon. It is an
observer-type that gazes on everything from
the outside without ever losing its broad smile.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a rat. It serves the Digimon
Sovereign Ebonwumon. It boasts great
wisdom, and plays the part of the “challenger”
in Ebonwumon's Zen Koans.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles an ox. It serves the Digimon
Sovereign Ebonwumon. It is a seeker of truth
who strives for detachment from material and
emotional concerns.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a Tiger. It serves the Digimon
Sovereign Azulongmon. It is the roughest of
the Devas and its expertise in tactics allows it
to gain a geographical advantage.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a rabbit. It serves the
Digimon Sovereign Azulongmon. It possesses
a gentle spirit.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a dragon. It serves the
Digimon Sovereign Azulongmon. It is
extremely calculating and hates to even lift a
finger if it won't benefit itself.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a snake. It serves the
Digimon Sovereign Zhuqiaomon. It is the most
cunning and cruel among the Deva.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a horse. It serves the
Digimon Sovereign Zhuqiaomon. It has an
insufferable, arrogant personality.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a sheep. It serves the
Digimon Sovereign Zhuqiaomon and it has the
ability to dominate the dream world.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a monkey. It serves the
Digimon Sovereign Baihumon. It has the
curious property of not speaking and not
showing any emotions on its face.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a rooster. It serves the
Digimon Sovereign Baihumon. It likes to
quarrel and gossip above all else.

One of the Deva, an Ultimate-level Digimon
which resembles a dog. It serves the Digimon
Sovereign Baihumon. It looks after its fellow
followers Makuramon and Shinduramon as if
they were its younger brothers.

Its body, which is made of Red Digizoid that
was re-purified from the virtual super-metal
Chrome Digizoid, which has increased
hardness, deflects every attack and can
destroy anything.

With its whole body in 100% full metal, it is
the Digital World's strongest Digimon. With
enough strength to overwhelm other Digimon,
it boasts of its incomparable processing
power.

The final form of the Seadramon-species,
whose whole body is covered in the strongest
metal, Chrome Digizoid. Its Metal Body repels
all attacks.

The Crack team has secretly designed this
extraordinarily large Digimon in order to
further expand its area of influence. It has the
ability to control the sea, and its cruising range
covers the vast net ocean.

It is the general of the Moonlight Army of the
Big Death-Stars. It forgot its emotions as a
consequence of always lurking in the dark, and
even slaughter has become part of its life that
it neither likes nor dislikes.

It is the general of the Fire-fury Army of the

Big Death-Stars. By liquidizing itself and

Big Death-Stars. It is a tactician that has the

battle at will.

On its mission as a true hero, it must win
100% of its battles. Wielding one of the
hardest and strongest in its class, the “Brave
Shield” and the “Dramon Killers”, it has united
the perfect Offense and Defense equipment.

equipped with the vernier boosters on its

truly the “Hero of ground-based combat” that

A Seraph-type Digimon, whose holy armor

An Ophanim-type Digimon that is the final

One of the Four Holy Beasts who protect the

beast whose powers are comparable to that of

One of the Four Holy Beasts who protect the

the Ten Legendary Warriors who saved the

Digimon who existed only in the distant past, it

Possessing the attribute of darkness, it is one
of the Ten Legendary Warriors who saved the
ancient Digital World. An Ultimate-level
Digimon who existed only in the distant past, it
is feared as the “Deadly Dark Beast”.

Possessing the attribute of earth, it is one of
the Ten Legendary Warriors who saved the
ancient Digital World. An Ultimate-level
Digimon who existed only in the distant past, it
has the highest power among the Ancient
Digimon.

This mysterious Digimon emerged when

power of darkness. Nobody knows its true

world.

An ultimate ancient-dragon Digimon that
existed in ancient times. There is a clear
distinction between it and other Digimon in
terms of existence and abilities.

This is a form of the ancient-dragon Digimon,
Imperialdramon, which has liberated all of its
power, changing form into the legendary
dragon warrior.

Imperialdramon, that acquired the power of
the holy knight Omnimon. Powering up

legendary holy knight.

This Digimon was fused from the Virus
Busters, WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon.

born due to the powerful wills of everyone

A holy-knight Digimon that, along with
Omnimon and Magnamon, is one of the Royal
Knights. It honors chivalry, and is a loyal vassal
to its lord.

A holy-knight Digimon that armor digivolved
through the power of the Digi- Egg of Miracles.

also has offensive power equivalent to that of a
Mega Digimon, or even greater.

As a member of the Royal Knights, it possesses
the power of a wyvern. It is a unique being

summoning humans into the Digital World.

In “Stop it Here” training, you practice stopping a huge spinning roulette wheel.

It mainly increases Max HP and it will also increase your Offense slightly.

In the Intermediate mode, you need to match the top and bottom of the wheel

by pressing the ○ button.

Stopping it on a “7” will always be successful.

In “Guard a Punch” training, your Partner blocks a huge boxing glove that flies at it.

It mainly increases Defense and it will also increase Brains slightly.

In the Intermediate Training, you match the timing of the machine with the ○ Button.

In “Bomb Evasion” training, bombs will fly toward your Partner, who will dodge them.

It mainly increases Speed and it will also increase your Max HP slightly.

In the Intermediate mode, you use the directional pad to dodge the bombs.

In “3D Ghost Leg” training, you trace the Ghost Leg to its goal.

It mainly increases Brains, but it will also increases your Max MP slightly.

In Intermediate mode, you need to choose the right starting point with the ○ Button.

There are six different ways of training in this gym.

Each machine increases different abilities.

it's generally recommended that first timers concentrate on raising one stat at a time.

Each training session lasts one hour.

While training, just press the × Button, to make the time pass immediately.

In addition to the basic training level, there's also Intermediate and Advanced Training.

so be careful.

Advanced Training requires faster reaction times than Intermediate, so be very careful!

In “Pulverize the Log” training, your Partner splits a log, by pulverizing it.

It mainly increases Offense and it will also increase your Speed slightly.

In the Intermediate mode, you'll need to time the attack with the ○ button.

It makes for an ideal way to practice using special skills!

In “Stop it Here” training, you practice stopping a huge spinning roulette wheel.

It mainly increases Max HP and it will also increase your Offense slightly.

In the Intermediate mode, you need to match the top and bottom of the wheel

by pressing the ○ button.

Stopping it on a “7” will always be successful.

In “Guard a Punch” training, your Partner blocks a huge boxing glove that flies at it.

It mainly increases Defense and it will also increase Brains slightly.

In the Intermediate Training, you match the timing of the machine with the ○ Button.

In “Bomb Evasion” training, bombs will fly toward your Partner, who will dodge them.

It mainly increases Speed and it will also increase your Max HP slightly.

In the Intermediate mode, you use the directional pad to dodge the bombs.

In “3D Ghost Leg” training, you trace the Ghost Leg to its goal.

It mainly increases Brains, but it will also increases your Max MP slightly.

In Intermediate mode, you need to choose the right starting point with the ○ Button.

In “Which One Is the Same” training, you are briefly shown a spinning die.

Then three others will appear, you must pick the one that matches the original.

When you and your Partner train, its stats will increase, and it'll be more useful in battle.

However, each session takes an hour, and training will wear your Digimon out.

When your Partner's fatigue level gets too high, let your Partner sleep.

You can also get rid of fatigue at the hospital, in the eastern part of the city.

Also, it's pretty rare, but you might be able to learn a new technique if you work out here.

Lastly, workouts with Fresh or In-Training Digimon are more effective!

There are six different ways of training in this gym.

Each machine increases different abilities.

Since it really differs from Digimon to Digimon which stats are easy to increase,

it's generally recommended that first timers concentrate on raising one stat at a time.

Each training session lasts one hour.

While training, just press the × Button, to make the time pass immediately.

In addition to the basic training level, there's also Intermediate and Advanced Training.

If you succeed at them, your Partner's stats will get a huge boost, but they can also fail,

so be careful.

Advanced Training requires faster reaction times than Intermediate, so be very careful!
Keep training harder and harder!

In “Pulverize the Log” training, your Partner splits a log, by pulverizing it.

It mainly increases Offense and it will also increase your Speed slightly.

In the Intermediate mode, you'll need to time the attack with the ○ button.

It makes for an ideal way to practice using special skills!

In “Stop it Here” training, you practice stopping a huge spinning roulette wheel.

It mainly increases Max HP and it will also increase your Offense slightly.

In the Intermediate mode, you need to match the top and bottom of the wheel

by pressing the ○ button.

Stopping it on a “7” will always be successful.

In “Guard a Punch” training, your Partner blocks a huge boxing glove that flies at it.
